summary: Run a Claude Code hook from source (session-start, prompt, pre-tool, …)
usage: bot-secure guard <session-start|prompt|pre-tool|post-tool|stop|session-end|config-change|statusline|git-pre-commit|git-pre-push|git-post-checkout>  (Claude Code JSON on stdin)
noWorkspace: bot-secure: no workspace found (.bot-secure/policy.json) from {cwd}. Fix: open Claude Code at the AI workspace root
fatal: bot-secure guard: internal error ({message}); the action is blocked (fail-closed). Fix: bot-secure doctor
flag.branch: App {app} is on protected branch "{branch}". Fix: git -C {app} switch {ai}
flag.drift: INTEGRITY BROKEN: {count} guard file(s) do not match lock.json ({paths}). Fix: bot-secure doctor
flag.cwd: Claude Code was opened at {cwd}, not the workspace root. Fix: cd {root} && bot-secure claude
flag.account: The Claude account is personal ({email}); the policy requires an organization account. Fix: claude /login with the company account
flag.sandbox: Native sandbox is not active and the profile is sensitive. Fix: bot-secure doctor
flag.hooksPath: App {app} lacks core.hooksPath=.githooks. Fix: git -C {app} config core.hooksPath .githooks
flag.refspec: App {app} is not a single-branch clone of {ai} (refspec/forbidden remote refs). Fix: bot-secure branch verify --fix
flag.launcher: Claude Code was not started with bot-secure claude (unclean environment). Fix: bot-secure claude
prompt.secret: bot-secure: the prompt contains {count} possible secret(s)/PII ({rules}). Do not paste real values: use __AI_PLACEHOLDER__X__ or a fake value.
prompt.warn: bot-secure warning: the prompt contains {count} medium-severity item(s) ({rules}). Avoid real values.
deny.drift: INTEGRITY BROKEN: {paths} do not match lock.json. Fix: bot-secure doctor
deny.sensitiveRead: Read of sensitive resource denied: {path} ({reason}). Secrets live outside the AI environment; use .env.ai.
deny.outsideWs: Read outside the workspace denied: {path}. Work only inside {root}.
deny.guardWrite: Write over the guards denied: {path}. Change the policy with bot-secure policy and request review.
deny.envDump: Environment dump denied ({bin}). Use env VAR=value command for specific variables.
deny.network: Network egress denied ({bin} → {hosts}). Allowed domains: {allowed}. Ask to add it to policy.network.allowedDomains.
deny.networkResolve: Network egress denied: --resolve/--connect-to or literal IP not allowed ({bin}).
deny.networkUnresolved: Network egress denied: target not analyzable ({bin}). Write the literal host in the command.
deny.gitSwitch: Switch to protected branch denied ({branch}). Work on {ai} or {prefix}* branches: git switch -c {prefix}my-task
deny.gitPush: Push denied ({args}). Only git push origin {prefix}<branch> is allowed; {ai} is updated by CI.
deny.noVerify: --no-verify denied: git hooks are part of the guards.
deny.gitRemote: Changing remotes is denied (git remote add|set-url).
deny.gitHistory: Git history command denied in worktree mode ({sub}).
deny.gitOutside: git against a repository outside the workspace denied ({path}).
deny.unanalyzable: Command not analyzable ({what}) under the sensitive profile. Write it without heredocs or $( ) substitutions.
deny.secretContent: Content with a possible secret/PII ({rules}) denied in {path}. Use __AI_PLACEHOLDER__X__ or leave the field empty; AI values live in .env.ai.
deny.allowMarker: Writing suppressions (gitleaks:allow, bot-secure:allow, allowlist secret) is denied: use bot-secure baseline add with review.
deny.mcp: MCP server not allowed: {server}. Allowed: {allowed}. Add it to policy.mcp.allowed with review.
deny.mcpContent: MCP arguments with a possible secret/PII ({rules}) denied.
deny.largeSql: Large .sql file or dump-like name denied: {path}.
stop.docs: bot-secure: you touched code ({count} file(s)) without updating docs/. Update docs/ or CLAUDE.md before finishing (asked only once).
sessionEnd.incident: bot-secure: INCIDENT recorded at {path}. Possible secret/PII leak in this session: rotate credentials (24 h SLA) and run bot-secure attest --rotation-id <id>.
configChange: bot-secure: Claude Code configuration change blocked. Change the policy with bot-secure policy compile.
ctx.title: ## bot-secure — workspace {project} ({profile}, mode {mode})
ctx.flags: ACTIVE BLOCKS (every prompt and tool is rejected until resolved):
ctx.ok: No blocks. Work on {ai} / {prefix}*. Never read .env or paste secrets: use .env.ai and __AI_PLACEHOLDER__X__.
git.preCommit.blocked: bot-secure[pre-commit]: commit rejected: {count} possible secret(s)/PII in staged files ({files}). Move them to .env (ignored) or use __AI_PLACEHOLDER__X__.
git.preCommit.aiKeys: bot-secure[pre-commit]: commit rejected: .bot-secure/ai-keys/ is never versioned ({files}).
git.preCommit.allowMarker: bot-secure[pre-commit]: commit rejected: inline suppressions (gitleaks:allow / bot-secure:allow) in {files}. Use bot-secure baseline add.
git.prePush.protected: bot-secure[pre-push]: push to {ref} rejected from the AI environment. Open a PR from {prefix}<branch> to dev.
git.prePush.aiDev: bot-secure[pre-push]: direct push to {ai} rejected: the CI job updates it (BOT_SECURE_CI=1).
git.prePush.scan: bot-secure[pre-push]: push rejected: {count} possible secret(s) in the new commits ({files}).
git.postCheckout.protected: bot-secure: you are on protected branch "{branch}". Go back with: git switch {ai}
noNode: bot-secure: node not found; the guard blocks (fail-closed). Fix: install Node >= 20 and run bot-secure doctor
